# Exact-pinned dependencies. Output must be byte-reproducible: a floating
# (>=) version could pull a newer ReportLab/python-docx/openpyxl on rebuild
# and silently change generated bytes, invalidating certification evidence
# tied to a hash. These versions produced the verified deterministic baseline;
# after any bump, re-verify it (see AI_README "Determinism contract").

jsonschema==4.26.0
python-docx==1.2.0
reportlab==4.4.10
Jinja2==3.1.6
